snippet.title: Tintin: Destination Adventure [PS1] Gameplay Walkthrough FULL GAME [4K60ᶠᵖˢ UHD🔴]
snippet.description:
Tintin: Destination Adventure Walkthrough Gameplay Longplay Part 1 featuring the intro and full story campaign. This video shows a complete no commentary playthrough of the PlayStation (PS1) version.

Tintin: Destination Adventure is also available on PlayStation and Microsoft Windows.

#retrogames #ps1 #playstationone

This is 4K60ᶠᵖˢ presentation of original Playstation native resolution upscaled and original game graphics captured. It is done this way to preserve original game appearance through modern high definition footage. No modern graphics enhancements are used at all.
